# Bell Perin

Bell Perin is a *fan-named background Earth-pony mare* in G4 **My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic**. Look for a warm yellow coat, pale blue mane and tail, pink eyes, and **three white daisies** as her cutie mark. She resembles Lemon Hearts in coloring, but has no horn. The [G4 Earth-pony directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) records her in *Winter Wrap Up* and the 2017 movie.

[![Bell Perin — Winter Wrap Up production still](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/2/28/Bell_Perin_ID_S1E11.png/revision/latest?cb=20110822003303)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Bell_Perin_ID_S1E11.png)

*Image: frame from Hasbro/Studio B Productions' television series; [episode production credits](https://www.intanibase.com/iad_entries/credits?shortID=15477). The file is listed in the show's image archive, though its detail page and asset could not be independently loaded.*

**Name and voice.** “Bell Perin” is a community identifier, not a verified on-screen, credits, or merchandise name. It may allude to *[Bellis perennis](https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/94326/bellis-perennis/details)*, the common daisy, matching her cutie mark; the name's actual origin remains unverified. No individually identifiable spoken lines or credited voice actor have been found. No verified disguise or alternate identity.

1. **Spring-cleanup work — “Winter Wrap Up” (S1E11).** She appears among Ponyville's workers during the seasonal preparations; a [character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/ru/wiki/Список_пони) describes her pulling a plow during the song. [Official song video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L9BAeyZhAdE); an exact scene timestamp is unavailable.
2. **A later background return — *My Little Pony: The Movie* (2017).** The character directory also identifies her in the film, but no individual action or dialogue has been verified. [Film synopsis](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony_The_Movie); precise scene timestamp unavailable.
